header.title: Promo campaigns
header.subtitle: Server-validated discounts and trackable campaign links.

noEvents.title: Create an event first
noEvents.body: Every campaign belongs to an event you manage.

empty.title: Your first campaign starts here
empty.body: Create a promo code with a validity window and redemption limit.

footnote: Figures come from confirmed BiletFlow orders: gross is the ticket subtotal, net is gross minus the promo discount (processing fees excluded). Refunded, pending, and failed orders are excluded. Visits count Campaign QR and link openings. All payments are simulated.

form.appliesToHelp: Leave all unchecked to discount every paid ticket type.
form.fixedTerms: The code and {discount} discount cannot change; disable this campaign and create a new one instead.
form.name: Campaign name
form.codeHelp: A unique code, such as CAMPUS20.

errors.endBeforeStart: The campaign must end after it starts.
errors.limitInvalid: The redemption limit must be a positive whole number.
errors.discountInvalid: Use a whole percentage from 1 to 100 or a positive KZT amount.
